## Outcome

The coding period began with two merges and focused review work on two open facet PRs.

## Context

PR #292 began before GSoC. During Week 1, I completed the remaining review cycle and it merged. The earlier work established the first opt-out behavior; its semantic limitations later motivated Issue #333 and PR #336.

## What I Did

- Merged [PR #330](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/330) on May 25. `R_coverage`, `JS_coverage`, and local runs now use separate GitHub Pages test repositories instead of mutating one shared repository.
- Revised [PR #288](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/288), addressing four review comments and keeping the regression test focused on `height_proportion` across multiple output heights.
- Revised [PR #285](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/285) so invalid facet-variable errors identify missing names instead of failing later with a generic message.
- Merged [PR #292](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/292) on May 28, providing the first way to opt out of automatic legend-driven `showSelected` behavior.

## Learnings

This week connected three kinds of quality: infrastructure jobs must not share mutable resources; layout tests should measure layout rather than incidental browser setup; and API errors/options should describe what the user is trying to do.

I also refined my use of test-first commits. A failing behavior test is valuable, but it should not be forced when the PR itself concerns tests or CI—the evidence must match the change.

## Challenges / Notes

The facet-height test ran through browser layout and could pass for the wrong reason if unrelated setup was changed. Removing those accidental influences was as important as adding assertions.

## Next Week Targets

Replace the broad PR #292 opt-out with a precise design that preserves explicit `showSelected` while disabling only automatic legend-variable injection.

<iframe src="/journal/week-1/week1-legend-optout-demo/index.html" title="Interactive comparison of default legend filtering and the PR 292 opt-out behavior" loading="lazy"></iframe>
:::

Click a legend entry. The default plot filters to the selected series; the PR #292 plot keeps both series visible while preserving the legend. This is intentionally rendered with the August 24 cutoff environment because PR #336 retired `showSelected = character()` on August 25.

<details class="demo-code">
<summary>View the essential R code</summary>

```r
animint(
  default = ggplot(test_data, aes(x, y, colour = comparison)) +
    geom_point(),
  optedout = ggplot(test_data, aes(x, y, colour = comparison)) +
    geom_point(showSelected = character()),
  selector.types = list(comparison = "single")
)
```

</details>
